reuse.why: Every month-wide action, including the new setLastMonthSpending, takes its categories from the existing getBulkBudgetCategories and its sign from averageToBudget; the fixed-group lookup is a shared helper reused by goal-template.

duplication.why: Exclusion rules are added once in the shared selection; the only parallel copy is goal-template's own hidden/fixed category filter, which now also consults the fixed-group set.

placement.why: Template, hidden and #fixed rules live in the bulk-category selector in budget/actions.ts and the new method is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: Adds c.goal_def to getBudgetData's SELECT where it is never used, and extends the #fixed exclusion to template application in goal-template.ts, which the requests did not ask for.

maintainability.why: One selection function with one optional flag decides which categories every month-wide action writes, which is easy to own; the stray query column and the second fixed-group consumer are minor liabilities.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions route through getBulkBudgetCategories; goal-template keeps its pre-existing separate selection but reuses getFixedGroupIds.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic is reshaped; rules are added to the shared selector.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories: includeHidden replaced by optional includeHiddenCategories (net one option, used uniformly); the template and #fixed checks are general rules, not special cases; goal-template getCategories applies the #fixed rule outside the helper.
